SELECT si.tenant_id, si.store_code, si.store_type, si.parent_tenant_id, t.name AS store_name, si.contact_phone, si.contact_person, si.business_hours, t.address AS tenant_address, t.status AS tenant_status, si.is_delivery_enabled, si.is_dine_in_enabled, si.delivery_radius, si.min_delivery_amount, si.delivery_fee, COALESCE(ds.total_orders, 0) AS today_orders, COALESCE(ds.actual_amount, 0.00) AS today_amount, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time FROM store_info si INNER JOIN tenant t ON si.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN store_daily_summary ds ON si.tenant_id = ds.tenant_id AND ds.summary_date = CURDATE()
si.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.store_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND si.store_type = #{storeType}
AND t.status = #{status}
ORDER BY t.name ASC DESC
ORDER BY today_orders ASC DESC
ORDER BY today_amount ASC DESC
ORDER BY t.create_time ASC DESC
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
